facts.fact: Malawi CERT, through MACRA, publicly alerted individuals, businesses and ISPs to the actively exploited MikroTik RouterOS vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-67276, CVE-2026-86060, CVE-2026-67277) and advised patching.
The article states Malawi CERT is a specialised unit under MACRA and the national focal point for coordinating cybersecurity incidents and threat responses.
